description: End-to-end test suite with three canonical flows scripted: (1) new MCP ingestion → signal scored → verdict → UI visible, (2) full approval loop: submission → verdict → analyst APPROVE/REJECT → attestation issued, (3) supply_chain/temporal_stability signal flat-discriminator diagnostic run verifying scores vary across at least 20 distinct metadata fingerprints. Uses synthetic MCPs with controlled metadata fields. Reports PASS/FAIL per scenario. Does not require live external APIs.
